name: Disk Cleaner
description: Find what is eating your disk — folder sizes, biggest files, junk cleanup, EthOS caches and Docker leftovers — with recoverable deletes.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.0.0: rebuilt on the shared EthOS shell with progress+cancel scans, a space map, trash-safe deletes, cache/Docker/journal cleanup and reclaim history. 1.0.1: light theme was white-on-white and is fixed; Browse… uses the EthOS folder picker; scans, deletes and journal vacuum report progress in the shared task panel; the Biggest files view parses again. 1.0.0: first release. The Disk Cleaner desktop app moves out of the core install; every delete still goes through EthOS's scoped file service.
